title: The Redemption Headroom on a Circle Benefit Credit
content:
## How much of what remains may be met from Circle benefit credit

The redemption headroom on a Northbeam Circle Membership is the part of what remains on a charge that may be
met from benefit credit at all, read from the benefit redemptions booked in the twelve months ending on the
handling day and the credit spent in that window.

1. Where the benefit redemptions booked in the twelve months ending on the handling day reach the yearly
   redemption allowance of the tier, no part of the charge is met from benefit credit, and the headroom
   stands at 0.
2. Where those redemptions reach the half allowance share of that allowance — one half, 50 percent, of it —
   but not the allowance itself, and the credit spent in that window stands at or above the delivery credit
   figure of the tier, the reduced headroom share of this schedule, 0.8 of what remains, is met.
3. Where neither of those holds, the whole of what remains is met, at a headroom of 1.

## The tier figures the readings turn on

| Tier | Yearly redemption allowance | One half of that allowance | Delivery credit figure (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Circle Plus Annual | 4 | 2 | 15.00 |
| Circle Total Annual | 12 | 6 | 60.00 |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 16 | 8 | 80.00 |
| Circle Business Pro | 40 | 20 | 120.00 |
| Circle Business Elite | 120 | 60 | 400.00 |

## Both sides of the boundaries

On Circle Total Household Annual, 16 redemptions booked in the window reach the allowance and no part of the
charge is met from benefit credit. Thirteen redemptions with 92.00 of credit spent in the window reach one
half of the allowance and stand at or above that tier's delivery credit figure of 80.00, so 0.8 of what
remains is met: on a remainder of 420.00, 336.00. Thirteen redemptions with 64.00 of credit spent in the
window do not reach that delivery credit figure, so the whole 420.00 is met. Six redemptions do not reach one
half of 16 either, and the whole remainder is met again.
